summary: Iteration 90: Anomaly Detection & Alert Management Testing. All 23 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: Security Alerts panel shows alerts with severity badges (CRITICAL/WARNING), acknowledge/dismiss buttons work, sidebar shows Audit Trail link under SUPER ADMIN section.

TEST_01_get_alerts_returns_200.notes: GET /alerts returns 200 with alerts list and total count

TEST_23_alert_has_details.notes: Alerts contain details field with context

STEP_01_panel_visible.notes: Security Alerts panel shows on Audit Trail page

STEP_03_alert_content.notes: Shows title, description, rule_id, timestamp, actor

STEP_04_acknowledge_button.notes: Acknowledge button present for active alerts

STEP_06_dismiss_removes_alert.notes: Dismissed alert removed from panel, toast shown

STEP_07_super_admin_section.notes: SUPER ADMIN section visible with Tenant Management, User Management, Audit Trail

STEP_09_alert_badge.notes: Alert badge shows when active alerts exist (0 active = no badge)

critical_code_review_comments: Anomaly detection engine properly implemented with 5 rules: excessive_impersonations, role_flip_flop, bulk_status_changes, off_hours_activity, rapid_password_resets
Alert endpoints properly protected with super_admin role check (403 for non-super-admin)
Default GET /alerts excludes dismissed alerts (status != dismissed)
Acknowledge/dismiss endpoints update status and record who/when
Frontend Security Alerts panel correctly displays severity badges, alert content, and action buttons
Sidebar alert badge correctly shows count of active alerts (hidden when 0)
seed_data_creation: Alerts generated during development: 1 excessive_impersonations (critical, acknowledged), 1 role_flip_flop (warning). To generate new alerts: perform 6+ impersonations or change a user's role 4+ times in 24h.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 90 verified complete Anomaly Detection & Alert Management system. Backend: GET /alerts (with severity/status filters), GET /alerts/unread-count, PUT /alerts/{id}/acknowledge, PUT /alerts/{id}/dismiss. All endpoints return 403 for non-super-admin. Frontend: Security Alerts panel on Audit Trail page shows alerts with CRITICAL/WARNING badges, acknowledge/dismiss buttons work. Sidebar shows alert badge when active alerts exist.
